_comment: REQUIRED trust policy for the pilot deploy role (review E5-08). Not created by this repository and NOT verified in AWS: the owner creates it, replacing <ACCOUNT_ID>, then verifies it. Until then AWS-side enforcement is an external gate.

The default subject of a job that uses `environment: pilot` is repo:amolam/setuhaul-logistics:environment:pilot. It names no branch, so a role trusting it would accept a dispatch from any branch that reaches the environment. Do not use it alone.

Required GitHub setting (owner, repository level): OIDC subject claim customisation with include_claim_keys ["repo", "context", "ref"]. The deploy job's subject then becomes the exact string below, binding repository, environment and branch together.
StringEquals only: no StringLike and no wildcard on sub, so no other repository, environment or branch matches.
